metadata.legal_basis_version: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 consolidated text consulted 2026-08-29; implementer must review amendments and product-specific laws before release.
metadata.disclaimer: Decision support only. A PASS means the supplied structured evidence passed these checks; it is not a legal opinion or certification.

rules.name: Manufacturer identity
rules.provision: Rule 6(1)(a); food packages require the applicable FSSAI declaration route
rules.fix: Declare the manufacturer's name and complete address.

rules.name: Manufacturer/packer relationship classification
rules.message: The system cannot determine whether a separately named packer is required.
rules.fix: Set manufacturer_is_packer to true/false from labelled declarations or a reviewer decision.

rules.name: Packer identity where distinct from manufacturer
rules.message: The packer is distinct from the manufacturer but packer details are incomplete.
rules.fix: Declare the packer's name and complete address.

rules.name: Importer identity
rules.message: The imported product's importer declaration is incomplete.
rules.fix: Declare the importer's name and complete address.

rules.name: Common or generic name
rules.message: The common or generic commodity name is missing.
rules.fix: Declare the common or generic name of the commodity; for multi-product packages include each product's name and number/quantity.

rules.name: Net quantity
rules.message: Net quantity is absent or cannot be parsed as a supported standard unit/count.
rules.fix: Declare net quantity using a standard unit of weight/measure, or number where the commodity is sold by number.

rules.name: Month and year of manufacture/pack/import
rules.message: The manufacture, packing, or import month and year is missing or invalid.
rules.fix: Declare a valid month and year, such as 08/2026 or August 2026.

rules.name: Best before/use by date
rules.provision: Rule 6(1)(d), where the commodity may become unfit for human consumption
rules.message: A best-before/use-by month and year is required for this perishable human-consumption commodity.
rules.fix: Declare the applicable best-before/use-by date in month-and-year form.

rules.name: Maximum retail price inclusive of taxes
rules.message: MRP must be presented as a complete retail-sale-price declaration inclusive of all taxes.
rules.fix: Use a declaration such as 'MRP Rs. 120.00 (inclusive of all taxes)'.

rules.name: Consumer-care details
rules.message: Consumer-care details are incomplete or invalid.
rules.fix: Declare consumer-care name, address, and a valid telephone number or email.

rules.name: Country of origin
rules.message: Country of origin/manufacture/assembly is required for imported products.
rules.fix: Declare the country of origin, manufacture, or assembly.

rules.name: Relevant dimensions
rules.fix: Declare the dimensions of the commodity, and each differing piece where applicable.

rules.name: Legibility and prominence
rules.message: Legibility/prominence cannot be established from text alone.
rules.fix: Use OCR bounding boxes and package imagery, then have a vision model or reviewer confirm legibility and prominence.
